name: weapons/warden_shot_crack
prompt:
summary: A static side view of a long heavy bolt-action sniper rifle on a bipod at an outdoor range, open hills behind it.

detailed_description:
[Shot 1] A static side view of a long heavy bolt-action sniper rifle on a bipod at an outdoor range, open hills behind it. It fires exactly one round: a big muzzle flash and recoil, then it is still. The camera is static and locked-off.

overall_soundscape: Foley recording, close microphone: one single enormous high-calibre sniper rifle gunshot, an instant ear-splitting supersonic crack together with a deep chest-thumping boom, then a long rolling echo across the open hills fading out over two seconds, then silence. Nothing else is heard: no music, no speech, no voices.
